selected_improvement: publisher digest/size exact-match gate before large APK GET
pilot_result: Positive Element X and negative Element Classic controls discriminated correctly with 1.530 seconds of API transfer time and 27,879 response bytes total; no APK GET.
recommendation: Use as a bounded candidate-selection check for publisher APIs with digest metadata; do not replace full APK hash, manifest, ZIP and signer verification or current owner admission.
next_evidence: A separately reviewed one-shot full GET with matching payload SHA/size and signer, plus a future case showing avoided retry; otherwise remain pilot.
stop_condition: API digest absent/mismatched, response identity drift, or any actual payload mismatch.
